notes.title: Patch 2022-05-22
notes.content:
>Added 4th level
>Added grenade launchers
>Added rocket launchers
>Added rapid-fire assault rifles
>Increased cover options across all levels

notes.title: Update 2022-04-10
notes.content:
-Changed computer interaction from UI based to console text
-Enemy lasers now track the player and move faster
-All items now display item info in the console when picked up

notes.title: Patch 2022-04-07
notes.content:
>Added distant geometry to level 1 to fill black background space
>Recompiled lighting using raytracing on all levels
>removed dynamic lights from baddies to help performance
>added dynamic FOV when using ADS
>added sniper scope UI when ADS with sniper
>removed 1-way doors where baddies spawn in level 2

notes.title: Performance optimizations
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where invisible damage numbers would stay on screen longer than intended
- Fixed an issue where lighting was always computed at runtime
- Tuned encounters on level 2
